contributor to MP (1881, 2) as Te Aroha, She was daughter of the Rev. Vicesimus Lush, Archdeacon of Waikato, of Auckland New Zealand.

Her married name was Ruddock. The slip accompanying payment of £2 17s. 6d. for her article \'A Trip to Norfolk Island\' MP (May 1881) is held by the Ewelme Cottage Museum
